ops.text: (iii) In addition, each of the Servicer and the Marketing Agent, severally and not jointly, will defend and indemnify the Customer and its Affiliates for all fees, expenses, losses, claims, actions, suits, damages and liabilities (including reasonable legal fees and expenses) resulting from any third-party claim to the extent arising out of (A) any allegation of infringement or misappropriation of any intellectual property right by the services, systems, software, reports or other deliverables provided or used by the Servicer or the Marketing Agent in performing its obligations under the Transaction Documents, (B) the Servicer's or the Marketing Agent's failure to comply with any Law applicable to it, or (C) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer data caused by the Servicer or the Marketing Agent, in each case without regard to whether such conduct constitutes willful misconduct, bad faith or gross negligence. Section 6.3(b) will apply to any such claim, and the Customer will reasonably cooperate in the defense of the claim.

input.comment: [Playbook] We extended Cellco's indemnity in Section 6.3(a) to cover third-party intellectual property infringement claims, failure to comply with Law and unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer data, and made it an express defence obligation running to us and our Affiliates, because the existing trigger (willful misconduct, bad faith or gross negligence) leaves us exposed on Cellco's servicing activities and its handling of that data. Section 6.3(b)'s notice and defence-control mechanics continue to apply, with a cooperation duty added.
input.summary: Add Servicer/Marketing Agent defence and indemnity of the Customer and its Affiliates for third-party IP infringement, non-compliance with Law and Cellco-caused data breaches
